name: @trajectonomics/site
description: The Trajectonomics Site at the root of trajectonomics.com: static Astro served by a Worker with Static Assets. Never published to npm.

scripts.predev: bun scripts/copy-fonts.ts && bun scripts/hero-ground.ts && bun scripts/llms-txt.ts && bun scripts/share-image.ts
scripts.prebuild: bun scripts/copy-fonts.ts && bun scripts/hero-ground.ts && bun scripts/llms-txt.ts && bun scripts/share-image.ts
scripts.prebuild:preview: bun scripts/copy-fonts.ts && bun scripts/hero-ground.ts && bun scripts/llms-txt.ts && bun scripts/share-image.ts
scripts.test:visual: bun run build && playwright test e2e/visual.e2e.ts
scripts.test:visual:update: bun run build && playwright test e2e/visual.e2e.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build:preview && SITE_BUILD_MODE=preview bun run verify:build && bun run build && bun run verify:build && bun run probe:status
